tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Points of large curvature in the limit have canonical neighborhoods] ↗ thm:short-time-blowup-limit

Every point of $(M_\infty ,g_\infty )$ with curvature greater than $4$ has a $(2C,2\epsilon )$-canonical neighborhood. \end{claim}
Proof

↗ thm:short-time-blowup-limit ↗ canonvary \sketch Exhaust the limit by the geometric convergence embeddings. The corresponding points have $(C,\epsilon )$-canonical neighborhoods of uniformly bounded diameter, and Proposition canonvary passes them to the limit.

□
